states: Exact-source compiled production Docs/router/Markdown renderer/styles in a synthetic shell; three fetched shipped guides match committed bytes. This is documentation proof, not Helm rendering, cluster rollout or installed recovery.

Both journeys show five exact copied recipes: pinned single-writer installation, static render and explicit namespace apply, separate OpenShift installation and same-version settings change retaining saved values.

Chromium 141.0.7390.37 desktop light and WebKit 26.0 narrow dark, Playwright 1.56.1. All 12 final captures were opened with the native image viewer; text and links wrap, with long commands contained in horizontally scrollable code blocks.
No document overflow or page errors; 22 same-origin read-only GET observations and exact guide-fetch checks. Browser and local server close successfully.
interactions: Desktop keyboard Enter and phone touch follow the actual pinned-install and existing-rollout links; Back and reload restore the correct fragment focus.
Static-manifest navigation uses the actual rendered heading ID while retaining strict focus checks. The first guessed-fragment timeout remains failed evidence, not a missing product page.
Narrow install code scrolls 75 px within its 288 px block (363 px content), without widening the document.
scope: New documentation receipt at its containing source parent; no runtime frontend source changed and no previous receipt was rebound.
